yeh ( kafir ) log kiss cheez kay baaray mein sawalaat ker rahey hain-?
uss zabardast waqaey kay baaray mein
jiss mein khud inn ki baaten mukhtalif hain !
khabrdar ! enhen boht jald pata lagg jaye ga ,
dobara khabrdar ! enhen boht jald pata lagg jaye ga .
kiya hum ney zameen ko aik bichona nahi banaya-?
aur paharon ko ( zameen mein garri hoi ) meekhen-?
aur tumhen ( mard o aurat kay ) jorron ki shakal mein hum ney peda kiya ,
aur tumhari neend ko thakan door kernay ka zariya hum ney banaya ,
aur raat ko perday ka sabab hum ney banaya ,
aur din ko rozi hasil kernay ka waqt hum ney qarar diya ,
aur hum ney hi tumharay oopper saat mazboot wajood ( aasman ) tameer kiye ,
aur hum ney hi aik dehakta huwa chiragh ( sooraj ) peda kiya ,
aur hum ney hi bharay huye badalon say moosladhaar paani barsaya ,
takay uss say ghalla aur doosri sabziyan bhi ugayen ,
aur ghaney baaghaat bhi .
yaqeen jano faislay ka din aik mutayyan waqt hai ,
woh din jab soor phoonka jaye ga to tum sabb foaj darr foaj chalay aao gay ,
aur aasman khol diya jaye ga , to uss kay darwazay hi darwazay ban jayen gay ,
aur paharon ko chalaya jaye ga to woh ret kay sarab ki shakal ikhtiyar kerlen gay ,
yaqeen jano jahannum ghaat lagaye bethi hai ,
woh sarkashon ka thikana hai
jiss mein woh muddaton iss tarah rahen gay
kay uss mein naa woh kissi thandak ka maza chaken gay , aur naa kissi peenay kay qabil cheez ka ,
siwaye garam paani aur peep lahoo kay ,
yeh unn ka poora poora badla hoga .
woh ( apney aemal kay ) hisab ka aqeedah nahi rakhtay thay ,
aur enhon ney humari aayaton ko barh charh ker jhutlaya tha .
aur hum ney her her cheez ko likh ker mehfooz ker rakha hai ,
.  abb maza chakho ! iss liye kay hum tumharay liye saza kay siwa kissi cheez mein izafa nahi keren gay .
jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya tha , unn ki beyshak bari jeet hai ,
baaghaat aur angoor !
aur no khez hum umar larkiyan !
aur chalaktay huye paymaney !
wahan per woh naa koi beyhooda baat sunen gay , aur naa koi jhooti baat ,
yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sila hoga . ( Allah ki ) aesi den hogi jo logon  kay aemal kay hisab say di jaye gi ,
ussi perwerdigar ki taraf say jo saray aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ka malik , boht meharban hai ! kissi ki majal nahi hai kay uss kay samney bol sakay .
jiss din sari roohen aur farishtay qataren bana ker kharray hon gay , uss din siwaye uss kay koi nahi bol sakay ga jissay khudaye rehman ney ijazat di ho , aur woh baat bhi theek kahey .
woh din hai jo bar-haq hai . abb jo chahye , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas thikana bana rakhay .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tumhen aik aesay azab say khabrdar kerdiya hai jo qareeb aaney wala hai , jiss din her shaks woh aemal aankhon say dekh ley ga jo uss kay haathon ney aagay bhej rakhay hain , aur kafir yeh kahey ga kay kaash ! mein mitti hojata .
